draft: Australian fiscal position/composition sources. Verified by download on 2026-10-12. finance-mfs, fbo-historical and abs-gdp-current-price are implemented in pipeline/au/fiscal.py (groups 'fiscal' and 'forecast'); other entries are research notes for other groups.

sources.format: xlsx (one sheet per financial year, e.g. '2026-27'; months as columns, items as rows)
sources.frequency: monthly (July and August published together; no June statement, the June outcome comes from the Final Budget Outcome)
sources.history: Aggregates 2000-01 onward (UCB, fiscal balance); cash receipts/payments rows from 2011-12 (blank July/August 2011, so monthly flows from 2011-10); net debt 2007-08 onward. Balance sheet, cashflow and function statements 2005-06 onward.
sources.unit: A$ billion in aggregates from 2020-21 (A$ million before); A$ million in statement files
sources.basis: Year-to-date cumulative (monthly = difference of YTD columns); cash (UCB) and accrual (fiscal balance) bases; not seasonally adjusted
sources.scope: Australian Government (Commonwealth) general government sector only
sources.revisions: Prior-year sheets reflect the month-by-month figures as published; final annual outcome is in the FBO, not the MFS file.

receipts.label: Receipts
receipts.sourceTitle: Aggregates: Receipts (cash receipts for operating activities and sales of non-financial assets)

payments.label: Payments
payments.sourceTitle: Aggregates: Payments (operating, purchases of non-financial assets, principal payments of lease liabilities)

fiscalBalance.label: Fiscal balance
fiscalBalance.sourceTitle: Aggregates: Fiscal balance (net operating balance less net capital investment)

governmentSecurities.label: Government securities (market value)
governmentSecurities.sourceTitle: Balance sheet: Interest bearing liabilities: Government securities. Market value, not the face-value gross debt measure.

interestBearingLiabilities.label: Interest bearing liabilities
interestBearingLiabilities.sourceTitle: Balance sheet: Total interest bearing liabilities

futureFundEarnings.label: Net Future Fund earnings
futureFundEarnings.sourceTitle: Aggregates: (less) Net Future Fund earnings, shown 2013-14 to 2019-20; deducted from UCB 2005-06 to 2019-20 (in 2011-12/2012-13 already netted out of 'Underlying Cash Receipts')

validation: Values in recent sheets are stored as text; coerce to numbers.
Columns are YTD except the first (July). The 2000-01 'August' column is a single month, not YTD; treat it as a special case.
Receipts - payments = underlying cash balance (2013-14 to 2019-20 also less net Future Fund earnings).
No June column: derive June as FBO annual outcome minus May YTD and label it a residual, or leave June missing.
Row order and labels change between years (e.g. 2000-07 AAS31 'Revenue(a)'/'Income', 2011-12 'Underlying Cash Receipts'); map by label, not position.
Units switch from $m to $b in the aggregates file from 2020-21.
2020-21 to 2022-23 values are rounded to $0.1b; identity tolerance is three rounding units per month.

Monthly profiles file: column header kinds are ACTUAL* (no profile published), Budget Profile, MYEFO Profile, Revised Budget Profile; each month's profile is added with that month's statement and there is no June. A full 12-month single-vintage profile is therefore never published in this file.
sources.discovery: Resource URLs are discovered on every run from discoveryUrl (CKAN package_show) by resource name: 'Aggregates - ...' (actuals) and 'Aggregates Monthly Profiles - ...' (Budget profile). downloadUrl/relatedDownloads are the URLs seen on 2026-10-12 and are not used by the code.

outputMapping.borrowing: minus Underlying cash balance (monthly flow, A$m)
outputMapping.debtPct: derived: net debt / ABS four-quarter GDP

sources.format: DOCX (Word tables; no xlsx/csv). Parse word/document.xml tables. PDF also available.
sources.latestObservation: 2025-26 outcome (FBO); BP1 Statement 11 of the 2026-27 Budget carries estimates to 2029-30
sources.frequency: annual (FBO each September; Budget/MYEFO add estimates)
sources.history: Cash receipts/payments/UCB, net debt, AGS face value: 1970-71 onward. Accrual revenue/expenses/fiscal balance: 1996-97 onward. Net worth: 1999-00 onward.
sources.unit: A$ million and published % of GDP
sources.basis: Financial years ending 30 June; cash and accrual; published % GDP uses Treasury's nominal GDP
sources.scope: Australian Government (Commonwealth) general government sector; Table B.9/B.10 also PNFC and non-financial public sector

tables.B.1: Receipts, payments, net Future Fund earnings, underlying cash balance ($m, % GDP, real growth)
tables.B.2: Net cash flows from investments in financial assets for policy purposes; headline cash balance
tables.B.4: Net debt and net interest payments
tables.B.5: Face value of Australian Government Securities on issue (gross debt) and interest paid
tables.B.6: Accrual revenue, expenses, net operating balance, net capital investment, fiscal balance
tables.B.7: Net worth and net financial worth
tables.B.9: Cash receipts, payments and surplus by institutional sector
tables.B.10: Accrual revenue, expenses and fiscal balance by institutional sector
tables.B.11: Receipts, payments, UCB per capita (A$ per person; inferred from magnitudes, 2025-26 receipts 27,287)

sources.discovery: The adapter tries the FBO edition for the latest MFS financial year, then the two previous years, using appendixBUrls[fy] if present else appendixBUrlTemplate. Add an appendixBUrls entry each September if the published path differs from the template. The edition used must end in its own year.
validation: Each table is split across two Word tables (to 2009-10, then 2010-11 onward); concatenate them.
Header rows use merged cells and empty spacer columns; map columns by position per table and check against known values (2025-26 UCB -22,254; net debt 549,969 = 18.8% GDP).
Rows marked '(e)' are estimates in the Budget edition; exclude them from outturn history.
sources.use: Annual history (fiscal.json 'annual', Tables B.1, B.2, B.4, B.5, B.6) and June residuals (FBO annual less MFS May YTD; June net debt = FBO end-of-year).

sources.history: Two outcome years per edition (2024-25 and 2025-26 outcome, plus 2025-26 Budget estimate). A longer series needs one FBO edition per year.
sources.basis: Accrual expenses by Australian Government budget function and sub-function (not COFOG)
validation: Sub-function labels can wrap across two rows (e.g. 'Assistance to the unemployed and' / 'the sick'); join them.
Includes general purpose inter-government transactions (GST payments to states), which are not final spending.

sources.format: xlsx (ABS formatted tables, sheets Table_1..Table_4; not the ABS time-series layout; no SDMX dataflow in the ABS Data API)
sources.table: Table 939 (DO021) General government, all levels: Table_1 operating statement, Table_2 cash flow, Table_3 balance sheet, Table_4 expenses by purpose
sources.history: 2015-16 to 2024-25 (10 years) in each per-level workbook
sources.basis: ABS GFS (IMF GFSM 2014-aligned), accrual; expenses by purpose use COFOG-A divisions
sources.scope: Level of government x sector: Commonwealth (130), each state (231-238), total state (239), local, all levels (939); GG, PNFC, NFPS, PFC, total public sector
sources.discovery: File names embed the reference year (55120DOnnn_YYYYYY). Scrape the latest-release page for the DO021/DO094 links.
validation: Eleven purpose divisions sum to total expenses.

All-levels figures are consolidated: Commonwealth grants to states are netted out. Commonwealth + state columns do not add to the all-levels total (2024-25: Commonwealth 745,029; all levels 1,030,511).
Commonwealth general public services includes GST and other grants to states; do not compare it with UK functions without consolidating.
Net debt % GDP by level is in key tables Table_16 (DO094).

sources.history: Only the latest four quarters in each workbook; a longer history means archiving successive releases (inferred: none found in the ABS Data API)
sources.scope: GG all levels, Commonwealth GG, total state and local GG, each state; Commonwealth and total state balance sheets; key fiscal aggregates (Table 15)
validation: Previously catalogue 5519.0.55.001; the file name changes every quarter.

sources.format: SDMX-CSV (ABS Data API); xlsx time series (sheet Data1) as fallback
sources.dataset: 5206.0 Table 3 / ABS Data API ANA_AGG key M3.GPM.10.AUS.Q
sources.basis: GDP, current prices, original (not seasonally adjusted). Sum the four quarters ending June to get financial-year GDP. Dashboard scaling, not an official fiscal ratio.
validation: SA equivalent A2304418T (SDMX TSEST 20); trend A2304350J.
FY2025-26 sum (Sep-25..Jun-26) = 2,927,146; FBO net debt 549,969 / that = 18.8%, matching the published ratio.
Treasury's own nominal GDP is in https://budget.gov.au/content/bp1/download/bp1_s2-data-nominal-GDP.xlsx (forecasts, not used for history).
sources.use: fiscal.json gdp.observations: four-quarter rolling sums keyed at quarter-end month (from 1999), denominator for derived debtPct (max two-month lag).
sources.publicationDateNote: The SDMX-CSV response carries no release date; gdp.releaseDate is null.
